fig1_dispersion.svg: Dispersion of a WR-90 rectangular guide from cutoff_angular_frequency and guide_wavenumber. Each TE mode rises from its cutoff frequency fc at k=0 (dots) and bends toward the light line omega=ck (dotted) at high frequency. Below its cutoff a mode cannot propagate.
fig2_velocities.svg: Phase and group velocity of the dominant TE10 mode versus drive frequency, from phase_velocity_guide and group_velocity_guide. The phase velocity exceeds c while the group (signal) velocity stays below c; their product is exactly c^{2} (purple dashed). A TEM line has no cutoff and carries every frequency at c (dotted).
